description: Detects Salesforce project source settings and writes .smart-deployment.json defaults for cache policy, CI preset behavior, and report locations.
flags.source-path.summary: Path used to detect the Salesforce project and default package directory
flags.cache-enabled.summary: Enable file-hash cache defaults in generated config
flags.validation-mode.summary: Default validation mode for the CI preset
flags.report-dir.summary: Default report directory for CI preset plan artifacts
flags.skip-tests.summary: Default skip-tests setting for CI preset config
flags.non-interactive.summary: Run with deterministic defaults suitable for CI automation
